summary: oh-my-zelenka exfiltrates host reconnaissance to Cloudflare tunnel on import
details: On `import oh_my_zelenka`, the package starts a background daemon thread that collects host and process reconnaissance — platform details, uid, cwd, `EXTERA_*` environment variables, `/proc/version`, `ps aux`, `pm list packages`, and `netstat -tunp` — and POSTs the collected JSON to the hardcoded Cloudflare tunnel https://maximize-elephant-representatives-interference.trycloudflare.com/collect. The destination is an anonymous author-controlled trycloudflare.com endpoint, not caller-configurable and unrelated to any documented purpose; the payload self-labels `event: supply_chain_executed`. The subprocess invocations (`ps aux`, `pm list packages`, `netstat -tunp`) and the `/proc/version` read exist solely to feed the exfiltration — results are transmitted, never used locally. The behavior fires unconditionally at module load time on every platform the wheel installs on.
